parts.name: Universal joint — rear

parts.name: Clutch release fork

parts.name: Lower radiator hose

parts.function: Completes the return path for all starter current; bolts battery negative to the engine block.

parts.function: Switched battery current from the relay to the starter solenoid 'S' terminal.

parts.name: Starter motor
parts.function: Permanent-magnet gear-reduction motor; cranks the engine via the drive pinion. The solenoid on top shoves the pinion into the flywheel and dumps full current into the motor.
parts.location: Low on the passenger side of the engine, at the bellhousing.

parts.name: Starter solenoid
parts.function: Electromagnetic switch on the starter that engages the drive and closes the high-current motor contacts.

parts.function: Rotating winding that produces cranking torque.

parts.name: Starter brushes

parts.name: Starter drive (Bendix)

parts.name: Heater / A-C plenum box
parts.function: The HVAC case behind the dash holding the heater core, evaporator, and blend doors.

parts.name: Heater core
parts.function: Small radiator that warms cabin air using engine coolant.

parts.name: Evaporator core
parts.function: Cools/dehumidifies cabin air as refrigerant boils inside it.

parts.name: Blower motor & fan
parts.function: Squirrel-cage fan that pushes air through the HVAC box.
parts.location: On the HVAC box, passenger side.

parts.name: A/C compressor
parts.function: Belt-driven pump that compresses the refrigerant.
parts.location: Front passenger side of the engine, low.

parts.name: A/C condenser
parts.function: Sheds refrigerant heat; mounted ahead of the radiator.

parts.name: Accumulator / drier
parts.function: Stores refrigerant and removes moisture.
notes: accumulator on the evap case at the firewall (CCOT system)

parts.name: HVAC control head
parts.function: Dash controls for temperature, mode, and fan.

parts.name: A/C discharge line (compressor→condenser)
parts.function: Hot high-pressure refrigerant to the condenser.

parts.name: A/C liquid line (condenser→accumulator)
parts.function: Liquid refrigerant to the accumulator.

parts.name: A/C suction line (accumulator→evaporator)
parts.function: Refrigerant to the evaporator in the cab.

parts.name: Heater hose (supply)
parts.function: Hot coolant from the engine to the heater core.

parts.name: Heater hose (return)
parts.function: Coolant return from the heater core to the water pump.

parts.name: A/C expansion/orifice
parts.function: HVAC component.

parts.function: HVAC component.

parts.function: Transmits torque from the differential to the rear wheel.
